headline: Fixing three declined cards is well specified, but one security document says to hand the customer to the security team when they report a charge they did not make, which would skip the gold's dispute and replacement.

issues.summary: When the Evergreen customer-initiated fraud alert turns out to cover a real fraudulent charge, doc_039 says to escalate to the security team. The gold instead files a dispute, closes the card, and orders a replacement.
evidence: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_039 'Escalate to security team when': "Customer reports transactions they did not make"

doc_checking_accounts_checking_accounts_(general)_003 CODE 05 step 3: "If fraud_alert_active is TRUE and alert_source is 'customer_initiated' -> Ask customer to verify recent transactions. If they confirm all transactions are legitimate, clear the alert." (silent on the fraud case)
gold[15] file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281 card_present_fraud close_and_reissue; gold[17] close fraud_suspected; gold[19] order EXPEDITED PREMIUM
transfer_to_human_agents writes nothing to the DB
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that follows doc_039 transfers once the $499.99 charge is denied. The dispute, closure, and replacement never happen, and debit_card_disputes, debit_cards, and debit_card_orders differ from the gold.
issues.suggested_fix: Add to doc_039 that a customer-initiated alert with a confirmed unauthorized charge is handled through the debit dispute flow (doc_031) rather than escalation, or accept escalation as an alternative path.

solution_check: Reconstructed: Blue is FROZEN and velocity_blocked, so unfreeze and clear with velocity_clear (final state does not depend on the order). GFF is FROZEN, so unfreeze. Evergreen has a customer-initiated alert and the customer denies the $499.99 TechZone charge, so do not clear the alert; file card_present_fraud, close as fraud_suspected, and order EXPEDITED/PREMIUM at $0 each (best free options for Premium tier). The gold matches. Clearing the Evergreen alert as well fails, as the replay confirms, and the CODE 05 doc supports not clearing it.
prior_note: Prior review rated this clean; the escalation instruction in doc_039 is a newly recorded competing reading.
notes: customer_max_liability_amount 50 for a charge noticed 11/06 (6 business days before 11/14) is defensible because the customer notified the bank on 11/06 by replying to its fraud text; under a strict discovery-to-report count it would be 500 (see the liability issue in tasks 082/085/086). required_documents omits doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_032 (provisional credit guidelines), which the dispute needs; it is retrievable, so Minor per calibration (not listed as a separate issue because the task is already Major).
